thread:
tony_sales: Acme POC — demo tomorrow 9am PT. Their dev reports 401 on every request using the project key we gave them. @sam_se can you help triage? stack: Node/Express calling /v1/generate
sam_se: Yep, send the exact curl + response body and I’ll take a look
tony_sales: Here’s what they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_proj_abc123" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp" \
  -d '\"{\\\"input\\\":\\\"hello\\\"}\"'
```
Response:
```
{"error":{"code":"unauthorized","message":"invalid API key or org mismatch"}}
```
jules_eng: Looks like a project-scoped key. Project keys typically require an explicit project header (X-Redwood-Project) or the request to use a project-bound token. Also check the key prefix: sk_proj_ vs sk_org_ — that tells you the scope of the key
tony_sales: Key is sk_proj_abc123 — we assumed X-Redwood-Org would be enough. What should we add?
jules_eng: Add the project header: `X-Redwood-Project: proj-77a2` (keep the org header). Alternatively use an org-level key (sk_org_...) if they need cross-project access. Also verify the key has scope `inference:generate`
maria_support: I looked up that key in the console — it was created through the project invite flow and currently has only `read` scope. I can update the scopes to add inference if you want me to flip it on now
sam_se: Tony — if you can ask their engineer to retry, have them run with the project header. If they can’t, I can create a temporary test key and DM creds for the demo
tony_sales: Trying the project header now...
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_proj_abc123" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-corp" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Project: proj-77a2" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Success! 200 OK and tokens returned. :tada: Demo looks good. Please revoke/rotate temp creds after the call @maria_support
maria_support: Will rotate and tighten ACLs after the demo. Also creating a short KB note to avoid this confusion for future presales calls :memo:
presales-bot: Recommend linking to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#project-vs-org-keys — includes example headers and common gotchas.
jules_eng: Nice. For longer-term POCs suggest using org-level service keys or a server-side token proxy to avoid key scoping issues. Closing unless anything else pops up :white_check_mark:
